name: Sophie Martin

employment.title: Security Engineer
employment.summary: Led security reviews for backend services and internal tooling using threat modeling (STRIDE/LINDDUN); reduced critical vulnerability backlog by 35% via standardized SAST/DAST gating and remediation partnership; implemented cloud security guardrails for AWS/GCP; built detections for credential misuse/abnormal access patterns; partnered with incident response on root-cause analysis and hardening actions.

employment.title: Security Engineer
employment.summary: Performed application and infrastructure security assessments aligned to OWASP/NIST; conducted API-focused penetration testing and web application assessments; automated vulnerability triage workflows with Python/CLI; supported SOC operations (investigations, log analysis, detection improvements); improved secure SDLC via threat-model templates, security checklists, and engineering training.

employment.title: SECURITY ANALYST (Intern)
employment.summary: Assisted with vulnerability scanning and report preparation, including retesting high-severity issues; supported rule tuning and triage for alerting tools; documented procedures for handling sensitive artifacts and maintaining evidence during investigations.
